description: Domain enforcement conformance vectors for NMFAlternatingLeastSquares. Tests that V >= 0 and V rectangular and V finite are preconditions at the public entry point. Valid inputs produce non-negative factors.

preconditions.name: ragged_rows_rejected
preconditions.description: V with rows of different lengths triggers precondition

preconditions.name: nan_entry_rejected
preconditions.description: V with a NaN entry triggers precondition

preconditions.name: inf_entry_rejected
preconditions.description: V with an infinite entry triggers precondition

preconditions.name: negative_entry_rejected
preconditions.description: V with a negative entry triggers precondition (Lee-Seung requires V >= 0)

valid_inputs.name: all_zero_matrix_accepted
valid_inputs.description: All-zero V is valid (V >= 0); factors are non-negative

valid_inputs.name: positive_rectangular_matrix_accepted
valid_inputs.description: Standard positive rectangular V accepted; factors non-negative
